# RestoPOS

> RestoPOS is a cloud-based, multi-tenant Point-of-Sale (POS) and billing
> software for restaurants, cafes, bars, cloud kitchens and QSR chains.
> One web app runs everything from quick billing to a whole multi-branch
> restaurant chain — browser-based, no install.

RestoPOS helps a restaurant take orders, send them to the kitchen, accept
payments and generate tax-compliant invoices. It is built for restaurants
worldwide, with a country-aware tax engine that handles GST (India), VAT
and sales tax across 30+ countries — and a one-click "CA export" bundle
for Indian accounting compliance.

## What RestoPOS does

- Fast restaurant billing and GST / VAT / sales-tax-ready tax invoices
- QR-code table ordering — customers scan to order from their phone
- Realtime Kitchen Display System (KDS) — orders stream to the kitchen
- Paytm UPI, card and cash payments, with automatic UPI confirmation
- Multi-branch / multi-outlet management from one account
- Customer loyalty, gift cards and coupons
- Sales analytics and AI-style demand forecasting
- Inventory and recipe management
- Offline-capable billing that keeps working if the internet drops
- One-click CA / accountant export (India)

## Who it is for

Restaurant owners and managers, cafes, bars, dhabas, cloud kitchens,
quick-service restaurants (QSR), fine-dining venues and multi-outlet
restaurant chains — in India and internationally. It is positioned as an
affordable alternative to legacy restaurant POS systems.

## Pricing

Subscription tiers scale by number of outlets and staff seats; a free
trial is available. Restaurants connect their own payment account
(Paytm in India, Stripe elsewhere) — the platform holds no money.
